$comment: The 1203 object categories of LVIS v1 (https://www.lvisdataset.org), with their synonyms, how often each occurs in the dataset (f frequent, c common, r rare), and its WordNet 3.0 synset with every synset that one is a kind of. LVIS annotations are licensed CC BY 4.0. A name may carry a disambiguation in parentheses, which the prompt keeps and the label drops.
